posts.text: Donald Trump has a lifelong record of bankruptcies, stiffing small contractors, and failed schemes—from Trump Steaks to Trump University to a charitable foundation that was pure scam. Now as president he’s turned the White House into a personal enrichment machine. Raking in money at a scale he never could in private business. Monuments to his own ego—tearing down the East Wing for a ballroom, arches, his face on our money and passports.This is textbook corruption. We cannot normalize this grift.
